verdicts.reason: The two layouts are almost identical, and both share the same flaws. The SOLSTICE wordmark floats off-centre and doesn't line up with the left-aligned headline. The badges and CTA are pushed to the right while the headline and body copy sit on the left, so the column edges are ragged. The two badges nearly touch, and the wordmark is jammed under the circle. A edges ahead on vertical balance, with roughly equal top and bottom margins; B pushes the circle close to the top edge and leaves a larger empty band at the bottom.
